trap.label: do × make (desculpas)
trap.wrong: I’m sorry, it was my guilt. I did an error.
trap.right: I’m sorry, it was my fault. I made a mistake.
trap.why: Em português “culpa” traduz-se como guilt, mas guilt é o sentimento. Para responsabilidade por um erro, o inglês usa fault; e o erro se faz com make.

mcq.q: Sorry, I ___ a mistake in the bill.

fix.why: forget to + verbo = esquecer de fazer.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “It is my fault.”
Reescreva com forget to: “I didn’t call you. I forgot.”
Reescreva no passado: “I make a mistake in the bill.”
rewrite.answer: I made a mistake in the bill.
